public_input.query: My partner and I are visiting London for 3 days during Carnival week. She's obsessed with hitting all the famous London landmarks and iconic sights that everyone talks about - the Tower of London, Big Ben, all the must-see places. But I'm more interested in discovering hidden local gems and authentic places that locals actually go to, away from the tourist crowds. We want to experience both sides of London - the famous stuff she loves and the real local spots I'm drawn to. Can you help us plan something that balances both our interests?
